title: XSS completeness: dedicated file-upload XSS, AJAX/JSON XSS, and XSSI (Cross-Site Script Inclusion) detection
goal: ZAP active scan covers basic reflected/stored XSS but misses three Gruyere-confirmed variants: (1) File Upload XSS: when a file upload endpoint is found, attempt uploading an HTML file containing an XSS payload. If the server serves the uploaded file on the same domain without Content-Type: text/plain or Content-Disposition: attachment, the file executes scripts. Detection: upload <html><script>alert(1)</script></html>, check if GET to the uploaded path returns HTML with script tag. Finding: 'Stored XSS via Unrestricted HTML Upload'. (2) AJAX/JSON XSS: for AJAX endpoints returning JSON, inject XSS payloads into all parameters. Check if the JSON response embeds the unescaped payload AND if the response is served as text/html (triggering script execution when eval'd). ZAP scanner often misses this because it only checks HTML responses. (3) XSSI (Cross-Site Script Inclusion): check if JSON endpoints with sensitive data are accessible without SameSite cookie requirements. An attacker can include them via <script src='...'> and steal data. Detection: check if JSON responses that contain user data lack: X-Content-Type-Options, vary: Origin, or CSRF tokens. Finding: 'Cross-Site Script Inclusion - Data Leakage via JSONP or JSON without protection'. Implement as an extension to the existing ZAP runner (additional scanner IDs + custom scripts) and a standalone xss-extended runner for file upload + XSSI checks. WIZARD WIRING (mandatory): (1) Add to api/app/services/run_profiles.py: name=active-web-xss-extended, run_class=ACTIVE, tools=[xss-extended], required_approvals=1, approval_step_id: active-web-xss-extended. (2) Add profile active-web-xss-extended to FULL-EXTERNAL-WEB Phase 2 in api/app/services/assessment_chain.py. (3) Add to wizard.js resolveExecutionProfile: when Web tile + active or full depth, include active-web-xss-extended in planned profiles. (4) Add to scripts/acceptance_harness.py PROFILE_TOOL_MAP: active-web-xss-extended: [xss-extended].
scope: Gruyere benchmark: 3 XSS variants that ZAP misses. Current coverage gap: XSS via file upload ⚠️, XSS via AJAX/JSON ⚠️, XSSI ❌. To reach 80% Gruyere coverage these must be implemented.
generation_reason: Gruyere shows 3 XSS variants not covered by ZAP: file upload XSS, AJAX/JSON response injection, XSSI data leakage. These are needed to reach 80%+ coverage.
